instruction: After jobs.registry.Registry registers a job with custom retry settings, jobs registered later (with no overrides) also run with those custom settings: e.g. registering 'sync' with {'retry': {'max_attempts': 5}} and then 'report' with no overrides makes jobs.runner.run retry 'report' 5 times instead of the default 3. Find and fix the root cause. You may run the tests in tests/.
